note: Step 0 is deterministic: the parsers plus build_context_candidates.py give the same source map every run, so these are asserted exactly. Regenerate the sources with make_sources.py; never edit the fixtures by hand.

structure.comment: The docx nests a table inside a table cell; the xlsx has a merged header governing two columns and a formula cell with no cached value. A parser that stops recursing, drops the merged header, or invents a computed value changes these counts.

known_limitations.why: Scope detection matches the product token anywhere in the text. cb_negation.md says 「與 CB 乘客險無關」 -- it names CB only to deny applicability -- and is selected for a CB run anyway, then propagates to the rest of the file by inheritance.
known_limitations.if_this_changes: Detection learned to read the denial. That is an improvement: update `current` to "unselected" and move these ids into must_not_be_selected.

known_limitations.why: cb_process.md is in scope (6 of 8 units selected), but section 3 never repeats 'CB' and the inheritance chain does not reach it, so the paragraph holding the Vietnamese message 'Tải lên thất bại' and the code 'E102' is dropped. Since change 002 the audit does report this as an actionable miss (signal_unselected_within_boundary = 1) instead of filing it as outside the boundary -- the loss is now visible, but it still happens. The same literals survive via cb_spec.docx, which is why literal preservation still passes; in a real source with the message in only one place, it would not.
known_limitations.if_this_changes: Inheritance now covers a section inside an in-scope file. Move these ids into must_be_selected, and expect signal_unselected_within_boundary to drop to 0.

known_limitations.why: The paragraph quotes a Vietnamese UI message, yet its signal types are ['Structured Fact'] -- matched on the code E102, not on the message. Literal detection recognises a literal either from a column header that governs it or from a value-shaped pattern, and prose has neither, so literal_unselected_within_boundary reads 0 while a source-native message is being dropped. In a table the same message is detected, because the "Error Message" header governs the cell.
known_limitations.if_this_changes: Prose literal detection was added. Expect this unit to carry Literal Knowledge and literal_unselected_within_boundary to become 1. Note that signal types feed recovery and the audits, so that change alters which units are selected -- it belongs in its own change with its own evidence.

expected_report.comment: One actionable miss, and the audit names it. Before change 002 this read within=0 / outside=1, because the within test only knew three structural boundaries and a prose paragraph is none of them, so every signal miss in a Word or Markdown source was filed as not-a-finding.
